### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory containing nanoseq output (bambu/, fastqc/, minimap2/, nanoplot/, pipeline_info/) plus the reprocessed multiqc/multiqc_data/multiqc.parquet. |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Optional design table (TSV): sample name (or samplesheet group) in METADATA_ID_COL, one column per factor. GROUP_COL becomes the condition; columns named protocol, source_replicate and run_id feed the library preparation, source replicate and flow-cell run filters; other factors are carried as extra columns. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Design table id column. Auto-detected as the first column. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Design table factor the run compares, carried as the condition column. Auto-detected as the first factor column of METADATA_FILE. |

**Auto-detected** (set from the run's metadata / `params.json`; the route flags drive *Conditional routes* below): `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY`, `ANNOTATION_COLS`

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`bambu/counts_gene_long.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bambu/counts_gene_long.py) | Bambu's gene count matrix, melted to one row per sample and gene. | `sample`, `condition`, `gene_id`, `gene_biotype`, `count`, `cpm`, `log_cpm` |
| [`bambu/counts_transcript_long.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bambu/counts_transcript_long.py) | Bambu's transcript count matrix, melted to one row per sample and transcript. | `sample`, `condition`, `transcript_id`, `gene_id`, `gene_biotype`, `count`, `cpm`, `log_cpm` |
| [`bambu/sample_correlation.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bambu/sample_correlation.py) | Sample-to-sample expression correlation of a Bambu gene matrix. | `sample_id`, `condition`, `mean_correlation` |
| [`bambu/sample_pca.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bambu/sample_pca.py) | Sample structure of a Bambu gene matrix: PCA coordinates plus library metrics. | `sample_id`, `condition`, `dim_1`, `dim_2`, `dim_3`, `pc1_var_pct`, `pc2_var_pct`, `total_counts`, `n_genes_detected`, `pct_protein_coding`, `top50_share_pct` |
| [`bambu/top_variable_genes.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bambu/top_variable_genes.py) | The most variable genes of a Bambu matrix, on a log-CPM scale. | `gene_id`, `gene_biotype`, `log_cpm_variance` |
| [`dexseq/results.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/dexseq/results.py) | DEXSeq differential exon/transcript usage results (volcano schema). | `feature_id`, `gene_id`, `log2fc`, `pvalue`, `padj`, `significant`, `direction` |
| [`gtf/transcripts.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/gtf/transcripts.py) | Exon and CDS blocks of every transcript in a run's GTF/GFF annotations. | `transcript_id`, `gene_id`, `gene_name`, `chrom`, `start`, `end`, `feature`, `strand`, `transcript_class`, `sample`, `expression` |
| [`nanoplot/nanostats.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/nanoplot/nanostats.py) | NanoPlot's NanoStat summary, one row per sample. | `sample`, `n_reads`, `total_bases`, `total_gigabases`, `mean_read_length`, `median_read_length`, `read_length_n50`, `stdev_read_length`, `mean_read_quality`, `median_read_quality`, `longest_read_length`, `top_read_quality` |
| [`nanoplot/nanostats_quality.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/nanoplot/nanostats_quality.py) | The yield-above-quality-cutoff ladder of a NanoStat summary. | `sample`, `q_cutoff`, `n_reads`, `pct_reads`, `megabases` |
| [`nf-core/nanoseq/deseq2_results.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/nanoseq/recipes/deseq2_results.py) | DESeq2 results on Bambu counts, with labels a reader can read. | `contrast`, `gene_id`, `gene_biotype`, `feature_label`, `exon_id`, `base_mean`, `log2fc`, `lfc_se`, `pvalue`, `padj`, `log2_base_mean`, `neg_log10_padj`, `significant`, `direction` |
